requirements.title: Authoritative parents and acceptance files identified
Complete tests and acceptance commands reproduced
Environment, hashes, residuals and minima frozen
Light-front convention is explicit and internally consistent
GTMD Fourier sign and normalization are explicit
requirements.gap: Several analytic/model transforms encode signs in formulas or comments rather than typed transform objects.

requirements.title: bDelta and bTMD cannot alias
requirements.gap: Typed Cartesian APIs coexist with generic scalar b arrays throughout radial transforms and physics providers.

requirements.title: DeltaT, DeltaNT, pT, RT and measured qT are distinct
requirements.gap: Only partonic MomentumTransfer/PartonMomentum are typed; nuclear and measured coordinates are raw scalars/arrays.

requirements.title: Tensor sign adapter is centralized
Transverse rank and mass normalization are stored
requirements.gap: Rank exists in registry but transform calls accept bare integers and arbitrary scalar normalizations; mass convention is not an identity field.

requirements.title: Amp maps are a distinct interface class
requirements.gap: Wave amplitudes, overlaps and nuclear convolution callables lack a shared typed Amp protocol.

requirements.title: Dens/CP maps are a distinct interface class
requirements.gap: Positive matrices and CP response maps exist, but partial trace and positivity-domain metadata are not unified.

requirements.title: Match maps are a distinct interface class
requirements.gap: Scheme guards exist but values, scales and maps are separate containers.

requirements.title: Red maps are typed and composable
requirements.gap: Reductions are methods/functions returning arrays without declared domain/codomain identity or commutative certificates.

requirements.title: Proc maps are separate from operator/matching maps
requirements.gap: No common process object binds hard kernels, fragmentation, link/color weights and W+Y validity.

requirements.title: Decorated operator identity is mandatory
requirements.gap: Required fields are distributed among SampledGTMD, TMDEntry, TMDScheme, TMDScalePoint, PredictionTrace and CSV labels.

requirements.title: SectorSpace carries irreducible color, isospin, spin-1 and SO(2) OAM labels
Current correlators encoded as positive block tensors without numerical change
Path-groupoid link types and transformations encoded
Reductions commute on analytic two- and three-body LF models
Quark and gluon parents retain target-helicity matrices
GTMD to TMD/GPD/PDF/current reductions are explicit
requirements.gap: TMD/GPD/PDF exist; local-current convolution is separate and reduction identities are not decorated.

requirements.title: Projectors map helicity matrices to complete TMD bases
Typed transverse-rank transform includes mass convention
Positive-correlator representation used where physically applicable
Provenance graph has explicit replacement/exclusion relations
Every authoritative artifact is regression-compared
Injected scheme/coordinate/rank/sign/double-counting failures are rejected
QCD matching and nuclear composition form explicit hierarchy
Truncation is assessed at observable level

core_objects.name: SectorSpace
core_objects.responsibility: Typed direct-sum/product sector with irreducible color, flavor/isospin, spin and SO(2) OAM labels.
core_objects.physics_risk: Wrong direct sums silently identify flavor or angular-momentum sectors.

core_objects.name: Intertwiner
core_objects.physics_risk: Incorrect Clebsch-Gordan, Melosh or rank coupling signs.

core_objects.name: LFMassOperator
core_objects.responsibility: Convention-consistent light-front mass/Hamiltonian operator and eigenstate contract.
core_objects.physics_risk: Factor-of-two inconsistency with sqrt(2) light-front convention.

core_objects.name: FockState
core_objects.responsibility: Normalized sector-resolved LF state with amplitudes and truncation labels.
core_objects.physics_risk: Double counting or lost interference among NN, NNpi and non-nucleonic sectors.

core_objects.name: PathGroupoid
core_objects.responsibility: Typed Wilson-path objects and legal composition/inversion.
core_objects.physics_risk: Wrong T-odd sign or color universality class.

core_objects.name: WilsonTransport
core_objects.responsibility: Representation-aware transport along a PathGroupoid arrow.
core_objects.physics_risk: Mixing quark and gluon or f/d Wilson structures.

core_objects.name: GTMDOperator
core_objects.responsibility: Fully decorated bilocal operator and initial/final momentum fibers.
core_objects.physics_risk: Combining incompatible scheme, path, color or flavor objects.

core_objects.name: ReductionMap
core_objects.responsibility: Typed GTMD-to-TMD/GPD/PDF/current/OAM maps with convention certificates.
core_objects.physics_risk: Implicit Fourier sign, forward-limit or measure mismatch.

core_objects.name: MatchingMap
core_objects.physics_risk: Silent scheme conversion or double evolution.

core_objects.name: NuclearAmplitudeMap
core_objects.responsibility: Compose nucleon/quark/gluon amplitudes with spin-1 nuclear sectors before density reduction.
core_objects.physics_risk: Wrong recoil/order or double-counted nuclear response.

core_objects.name: PositiveCorrelator
core_objects.responsibility: PSD density/correlator with trace, partial trace and CP-map invariants.
core_objects.physics_risk: Positivity applied to the wrong object or hidden clipping.

core_objects.name: TruncationTower
core_objects.responsibility: Nested Fock/OAM/twist/model truncations with observable convergence evidence.
core_objects.physics_risk: Formal completeness confused with numerical convergence.

core_objects.name: ProvenanceComplex
core_objects.responsibility: Typed contribution graph with replacement, exclusion and cochain-like consistency relations.
core_objects.physics_risk: Patchwork double counting or temporary assumptions becoming invisible.

core_objects.name: EnsembleStore
core_objects.responsibility: Common storage of named uncertainty members, covariance semantics and correlations.
core_objects.physics_risk: Combining Hessian, replica and sensitivity bands as equivalent probabilities.

core_objects.name: ObservableLikelihood
core_objects.responsibility: Bind process prediction, data, nuisance parameters and likelihood/provenance.
core_objects.physics_risk: Parameter constraints detached from process/link/scheme definition.
